notes.title: Version Update Notification
notes.content:
Ver 1.30
- Added Hard stages (unlocked upon clearing normal)
- Added achievements related to Hard difficulty

notes.title: Bug Fix (2018/11/06)
notes.content: Fixed translation, achievements, and stage 1-4 arrow.

notes.title: Released Today!
notes.content: "MarisaLand Legacy" has finally been released! If you have any questions or bug reports please use the community hub to let us and others know.

notes.title: Publisher Comment
notes.content:
We hope you are looking forward to "MarisaLand Legacy"!

With its cute characters and lovely music, this game can be enjoyed alone or even more so with a group of friends.

Direction, Illustration, Music all performed by Uni Akiyama (U2)!

He is well known for his musical work on "Immaterial and Missing Power", "Scarlet Weather Rhapsody" and "Umineko When They Cry".

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
The translating is finished and we are now in the process of inserting the translated text into the game.
We are also planning on implementing (Steam) Achievements and Trading Cards!
If everything goes as planned we intend to release the game early next month (November 2018). In the meantime, we ask for your patience.
